custody.note: These records establish the program and initial candidates. Completed research waves must add evidence custody required by docs/research-agent-handoff.md.

sourceClasses.firstPartyDeveloper: Apple Developer news, release, or SDK documentation
sourceClasses.contemporaryJournalism: Dated reporting close to the appearance
sourceClasses.historicalJournalism: Reporting used to establish an older program boundary

sources.title: Apple Beta Software Program

locators.supports: The program currently lists iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, HomePod software, and AirPods firmware.
locators.qualification: The page does not list visionOS; omission is negative evidence, not conclusive proof that no separate distribution exists.

sources.title: FAQ

locators.supports: Apple describes public enrollment and feedback for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, HomePod, and Apple Watch.

sources.title: Apple Announces iPhone 2.0 Software Beta

locators.supports: Apple announced iPhone 2.0 beta software and immediate access for selected developers and enterprise customers.

sources.title: Apple Launches New iOS Beta Testing Program, Seeds iOS 8.3 to Testers

locators.locator: program launch and iOS 8.3 distribution paragraphs
locators.supports: Public iOS testing began with an iOS 8.3 seed on March 12, 2015, corresponding to developer beta 3.
locators.qualification: The initial audience was limited; this source preserves the public-program invitation context.

sources.title: Apple begins public beta testing of iOS

locators.supports: Independent contemporary corroboration that Apple began distributing iOS 8.3 through its public beta program.

sources.title: Apple Seeds Fourth iOS 8.3 Beta to Developers, Second Beta to Public Beta Testers

locators.supports: iOS 8.3 Public Beta 2 appeared March 24, 2015 alongside developer beta 4.

sources.title: Apple releases iOS 8.4 beta 2 to developers with revamped Music app

locators.supports: The first iOS 8.4 public beta appeared April 27, 2015 and corresponded to developer beta 2.

sources.title: Apple releases iOS 8.4 beta 3 with revamped Music app ahead of late June launch

locators.supports: iOS 8.4 Public Beta 2 appeared May 11, 2015 alongside developer beta 3.

sources.title: Apple Seeds Fourth iOS 8.4 Beta With Revamped Music App to Developers and Public Beta Testers

locators.supports: iOS 8.4 Public Beta 3 appeared June 9, 2015 alongside developer beta 4.

sources.title: The new iPadOS powers unique experiences designed for iPad

locators.supports: Apple made the iPadOS developer preview available June 3 and announced a public beta for later that month.

sources.title: Apple Releases First Public Betas of iOS 13 and iPadOS

locators.locator: headline and first public-beta availability paragraph
locators.supports: iPadOS 13 Public Beta 1 appeared June 24, 2019.

sources.title: Apple Previews Mac OS X Snow Leopard to Developers

locators.locator: press release heading and opening paragraphs
locators.supports: Apple previewed Mac OS X Snow Leopard to developers on June 9, 2008.
locators.qualification: This establishes the current corpus boundary, not the beginning of all Mac developer previews.

sources.title: Snow Leopard Seeded to WWDC Developers

locators.supports: Contemporary corroboration that a Snow Leopard seed was distributed to WWDC developers.

sources.title: Apple launches Beta Seed Program for OS X end users

locators.locator: program launch and OS X 10.9.3 paragraphs
locators.supports: Apple opened a recurring OS X beta seed program to end users with OS X 10.9.3 on April 22, 2014.

sources.title: Apple opens OS X beta program to the public for 10.9.3

locators.supports: Independent contemporary corroboration of the open OS X 10.9.3 beta program.

sources.title: Apple Releases Mac OS X Public Beta

locators.locator: press release heading and availability paragraphs
locators.supports: Apple released a separately named Mac OS X Public Beta product in 2000.
locators.qualification: This is not automatically equivalent to a recurring publicBeta channel appearance.

sources.title: Apple Previews New Apple Watch Software

locators.supports: Apple previewed watchOS 2 and made developer materials available June 8, 2015.

sources.title: watchOS 7 adds significant personalization, health, and fitness features to Apple Watch

locators.supports: Apple announced that watchOS 7 would be offered as a public beta for the first time.

sources.title: Apple Seeds First Public Beta of watchOS 7 to Public Beta Testers

locators.supports: watchOS 7 Public Beta 1 appeared August 10, 2020.

sources.title: Apple releases watchOS 7 public beta

locators.supports: Independent contemporary corroboration of the first watchOS public beta.

sources.title: Introducing tvOS

locators.supports: Apple introduced the tvOS SDK on September 9, 2015.
locators.qualification: An SDK is not itself proof of a device-OS build appearance.

sources.title: Apple Seeds First Public Beta of tvOS 11

locators.supports: tvOS 11 Public Beta 1 appeared June 26, 2017 and was the first tvOS public beta.

sources.title: visionOS SDK now available

locators.locator: Xcode 15 beta 2 and visionOS SDK paragraph
locators.supports: Apple made the visionOS SDK and simulator available June 21, 2023.
locators.qualification: SDK/simulator availability must not be silently converted into a device build claim.

sources.title: visionOS 27.0 beta (24M5291p)

locators.supports: Apple published a visionOS 27 developer beta release entry on June 8, 2026.
locators.qualification: This does not establish a public-beta appearance.

sources.title: Apple unveils next generation of Apple Intelligence, Siri AI, and more

locators.supports: Apple announced developer testing for its new operating systems and a public beta the following month.
locators.qualification: The singular generic public-beta language does not establish an exact appearance for every named platform.

sources.title: First macOS Golden Gate Public Beta Now Available

locators.supports: macOS 27 Public Beta 1 appeared July 13, 2026.

sources.title: macOS 27 public beta now available, here's how to install it

locators.locator: headline, opening paragraph, and Public Beta 1 installation heading
locators.supports: Independent corroboration of macOS 27 Public Beta 1 on July 13, 2026.

sources.title: tvOS 27 and watchOS 27 Now Available to Public Beta Testers

locators.supports: watchOS 27 and tvOS 27 Public Beta 1 appeared July 13, 2026.
locators.qualification: The report says they corresponded to developer beta 3; it does not by itself prove byte-for-byte identity.

sources.title: watchOS 27 public beta is here with Siri AI and smarter Apple Watch features

locators.locator: opening availability paragraph and enrollment steps
locators.supports: Independent corroboration that watchOS 27 Public Beta 1 was selectable on July 13, 2026.

sources.title: The OS 27 public betas are out now with Siri AI, platform improvements, and more

locators.supports: Corroborates July 13 public availability for tvOS 27 and claims public availability for visionOS 27.
locators.qualification: The visionOS claim conflicts with Apple's current enrollment-page omission and requires stronger proof.

sources.title: First iOS 27, macOS 27 public betas are out

locators.supports: Claims a visionOS 27 public beta alongside other OS 27 public betas.
locators.qualification: Do not adopt its visionOS or watchOS build strings without independent first-party verification.
